purpose: Module instruction -> role information -> operative coordinate reward -> trajectory -> final predicted quality

agent_replicates.downstream_Designer_in_Analyst_ablation: same frozen D0-G instructions; one independent fresh call per Analyst response; finalists optionally replayed
agent_replicates.designer_phase_Analyst_inputs: same six frozen A* responses for every Designer treatment; no generated quality data

execution_baseline.window_policy: derive from immutable learning/reference metadata; current [0,0.5] is descriptive, not a Skill literal

prospective_allowed_changes.region_recipe: data-bound sparse soft emphasis, positive outside-region weight; compiler/equivalence interface needs implementation

G.maximum_edits: one preregistered atomic geometry recipe; no contact/energy/new trajectory target

U.maximum_edits: one dose parameter; no shape or teacher edits

phase_order: P1 Analyst individual deletion/alternative then sequential pruning
P2 Designer shape then dose ablation with frozen Analyst output pool
P3 combination and final-context necessity checks

generation_plan.sample_size_freeze: estimate crossed role/batch variation using screen; freeze size before viewing confirmation outcomes
generation_plan.budget_formula: 200*U_screen + 400*U_confirmation + 400*U_final + distinct matched controls, before preregistered contingency
generation_plan.bound_interpretation: Counting draft slots, not mandatory distinct rewards or submitted tasks; equivalent designs can sharply reduce inference

evaluation.primary: mean final FLOWR predicted target pIC50 across attempted generation, with score coverage and missingness disclosed
secondary: MMFF strain relief per heavy atom median and p90
evaluation.elite_threshold_origin: historical frozen evaluation manifest; not a Skill literal
evaluation.historical_Steer_role: unpaired different-online-budget reference; preserved without rerun
evaluation.statistics: crossed role-chain and generation-batch blocked paired comparison; identical programs retain multiplicity as policy outcomes but do not become independent molecular samples
evaluation.multiplicity: Holm hypothesis tests; simultaneous CI construction must be preregistered by max-T or conservative familywise inversion before execution
evaluation.secondary_necessity: affinity equivalent plus confirmed >10% strain worsening under deletion and alternative

future_required_implementation: G/U bounded compiler and regional/M2 no-op equivalence
blinded functional scoring and evidence checks
effective numerical signatures and trajectory readouts
